title: CAN Algebra I | 36-week curriculum development blueprint
scopeNote: A provisional teaching sequence, not a school-approved course of study. All standards, lesson content, assessments, instructional time, support plans and graduation or UC A-G course recognition require qualified educator and school review. The 165-hour estimate assumes 36x5x55-minute sessions and is not evidence of delivered instruction.

weeks.title: Expressions, equations and inequality foundations
weeks.focus: Distinguish expressions, justify equation-solving steps, solve and interpret basic inequalities.

weeks.title: Multi-step equations and formulas
weeks.focus: Solve literal and multi-step linear equations and justify transformations in contextual formulas.

weeks.title: Linear problem solving and constraints
weeks.focus: Represent contextual quantities, units, bounds and inequalities in a mathematically justified model.

weeks.title: Unit 1 cumulative assessment and reteaching
weeks.focus: Demonstrate algebraic fluency and modeling with a scored checkpoint and targeted reassessment.

weeks.title: Functions, inputs, outputs and domains
weeks.focus: Interpret functions as relationships, evaluate notation and select sensible input domains.

weeks.title: Tables, graphs and multiple representations
weeks.focus: Connect function tables, graphs and verbal descriptions and interpret key features.

weeks.title: Average rate of change
weeks.focus: Calculate and explain changing quantities using function representations and units.

weeks.title: Functions unit review and transfer
weeks.focus: Compare representations and communicate domain, range and rate evidence on an assessed task.

weeks.title: Slope and linear equations
weeks.focus: Find rate of change from graphs, tables and contexts; distinguish slope from initial value.

weeks.title: Equivalent linear forms and graphing
weeks.focus: Move among slope-intercept, point-slope and standard forms to graph relationships.

weeks.title: Fitting and interpreting linear models
weeks.focus: Choose useful linear models for data and explain reasonable errors and constraints.

weeks.title: Linear model design challenge
weeks.focus: Build, critique and present a contextual linear model with teacher-reviewed evidence.

weeks.title: Systems by graphing
weeks.focus: Interpret the intersection of two linear functions as a solution to two constraints.

weeks.title: Systems by substitution
weeks.focus: Solve systems symbolically and verify ordered pairs in both original equations.

weeks.title: Systems by elimination
weeks.focus: Select a solution strategy, handle no/infinitely many solutions and explain meaning.

weeks.title: Systems application and assessment
weeks.focus: Model pricing and supply constraints using systems and communicate solutions.

weeks.title: Integer exponents and growth
weeks.focus: Apply exponent properties and explain multiplicative rather than additive change.

weeks.title: Arithmetic and geometric patterns
weeks.focus: Identify recursive and explicit sequence rules and relate patterns to functions.

weeks.title: Exponential functions
weeks.focus: Build growth and decay models and interpret initial values and growth factors.

weeks.title: Linear and exponential comparison
weeks.focus: Select models from data, critique extrapolation and complete a scored model comparison.

weeks.title: Polynomial operations
weeks.focus: Add, subtract and multiply polynomials, attending to structure and the distributive property.

weeks.title: Factoring quadratic expressions
weeks.focus: Use factoring to express equivalent quadratics and interpret zero-product solutions.

weeks.title: Quadratic identities and structure
weeks.focus: Relate equivalent polynomial forms and identify why each is useful.

weeks.title: Polynomials unit mastery and reteaching
weeks.focus: Demonstrate polynomial operations and factoring on assessed problems with error analysis.

weeks.title: Graphs of quadratic functions
weeks.focus: Interpret vertex, zeros, symmetry and direction of quadratic graphs in context.

weeks.title: Finding roots by factoring
weeks.focus: Solve quadratic equations using factoring and check solutions.

weeks.title: Complete the square and quadratic formula
weeks.focus: Select symbolic quadratic solution methods and explain roots in different cases.

weeks.title: Quadratic model investigations
weeks.focus: Fit and critique quadratic situations and communicate vertex and intercept meaning.

weeks.title: Square roots and real-number structure
weeks.focus: Reason about radicals, square-root values and when solutions are real.

weeks.title: Quadratic equations in context
weeks.focus: Translate measurement or motion contexts into solvable quadratic equations.

weeks.title: Transformations and function comparison
weeks.focus: Compare function transformations and explain changing parameters.

weeks.title: Nonlinear unit assessment
weeks.focus: Demonstrate method selection and interpretation on a teacher-scored transfer task.

weeks.title: Describing one-variable data
weeks.focus: Represent distributions and explain center, variability and outliers.

weeks.title: Bivariate data and residuals
weeks.focus: Fit lines to scatterplots, evaluate residuals and critique data collection.

weeks.title: Course synthesis capstone
weeks.focus: Model a real question using functions, equations and data with a documented source.

weeks.title: Final assessment and targeted reassessment
weeks.focus: Complete the cumulative Algebra I assessment, teacher feedback, reflection and interventions.
